request: Revalidate forecast features, correlations, importance and temporal relationships; reselect features, retrain and evaluate
source_policy: Read verified original and derived data; preserve all previous source, analysis and modeling artifacts
target: 13-module complete-hour energy sum, provisional kWh under original guide units
feature_availability: All sensor statistics are from completed hours strictly before the forecast origin; future calendar and forecast lead are known
excluded_features: sensor readings or hourly energy from the target/future hour
May hourly_pow, total agg_pow, derived bill and carbon as inputs
absolute cumulative counter levels used as unchecked proxies for date
constant operation and erroneous Unix time key

primary_task.output: Hourly energy path for origin..origin+23h, lead1..24 relative to the preceding completed-hour key
primary_task.selection_criterion: Validation path MAE; lead1/6/24 error reported separately
primary_task.feature_selection: Learned from each fold's historical fitting prefix only; test feature selection is fit on history ending March31
primary_task.input_update: Weights and feature names are fixed inside a validation fold or April test; input context updates with only observations prior to each daily origin

secondary_task.availability_limit: May contains only aggregate labels; future sensor inputs and an April30-May9 rolling history are unavailable
secondary_task.feature_selection: Fit with the long-validation fitting prefix, not its future labels; refit selection separately with the later fitting prefixes
secondary_task.selection: Freeze configurations on long validation before internal test and May scoring

diagnostics: Contemporaneous sensor/target correlations are descriptive and cannot be treated as future availability
Lagged Pearson/Spearman relationships, multiple-testing correction and stability by historical interval
Chronological validation permutation importance and feature-group ablation alongside training importance
Autocorrelation, calendar effects, feature redundancy and conditional aggregation-noise checks
Past context perturbation and target-index checks to detect accidental future leakage
interpretation_limits: April and May were examined in previous work; this is a post-EDA feature revision, not a pristine prospective blind test
Univariate old models and multivariate new models have different information scopes; the effect is not attributed solely to hyperparameters
More features do not guarantee lower test MAE or positive R2
No global optimum or current absolute SOTA claim
Meter hierarchy and units remain unresolved; no unsupported unit correction is applied
